Chapter 1300: 43: My Turn

Chapter 1300: Chapter 43: My Turn

Since he plans to fully support Lin Yuan, even if Lin Yuan takes all six Eternal Sources, the Sect Master of the Eternal Infinite Sect would not frown.

Buzz~

With a flip of his right hand, Lin Yuan caused five of the six floating Eternal Sources to silently vanish.

Incorporated into Lin Yuan’s body.

In an instant.

The five Eternal Sources provided an ocean of energy, allowing Lin Yuan’s remaining particles to rapidly open up new worlds.

Rumble.

As the five Eternal Sources disappeared.

Outside the secret world.

Several Eternal Treasures, which were resisting the Demon God’s attacks, suddenly saw their power plummet.

Even though one Eternal Source still supplied energy, its instant supply efficiency could not compare to having all six.

“Not good.”

The Sect Master’s face changed dramatically.

He had not anticipated this scene.

Originally, he thought the six Eternal Sources could sustain the secret world for millions of years.

One Eternal Source alone was more than enough for hundreds of thousands of years.

However, losing the simultaneous supply of six Eternal Sources made it difficult for just one to maintain so many Eternal Treasures.

“Hmm?”

Lin Yuan also noticed the change in the external Eternal Treasures.

“No need to worry.”

Lin Yuan glanced at the sect masters.

Since he took five Eternal Sources, Lin Yuan would not take them for nothing.

Even if the remaining ten percent of particles were rapidly opening up, it did not affect Lin Yuan’s ability to act.

“Leave the rest to me.”

Lin Yuan took a step forward and disappeared from the spot.

Before the sect masters and the sect leaders could react.

The world outside was filled with a colossal figure standing tall.

The calm-faced Lin Yuan stood beside the secret world, which had been opened by the Eternal Lords, only reaching his ankles.

An invisible field descended and spread, forming barriers to actively block the attacks from the Demon God.

“What?”

“Lord Galaxy has gone out?”

The Sect Master and others were somewhat dazed.

Lin Yuan had mentioned having a way to deal with the Demon God, along with requesting the Eternal Sources.

This led the sect masters to subconsciously speculate that Lin Yuan must have obtained a powerful Eternal Treasure.

Requesting the Eternal Sources was to activate this Eternal Treasure.

This was why the sect masters ultimately decided to pin their hopes on Lin Yuan.

If it were indeed an extremely powerful Eternal Treasure, there would be a faint hope of resisting the Demon God with ample Eternal Sources.

But now?

Lin Yuan went out himself to confront the Demon God?

Though at this moment Lin Yuan stood tall and majestic, with an aura vast and boundless.

The enemy is the Demon God, on par with a thirteenth-tier Eternal Lord.

“Hiss~” Black streams first struck the barrier Lin Yuan had formed.

This attack method was the Demon God utilizing the eroding power of Demonic Qi to instinctively strike.

The corrosive power of the black stream was hard for even Eternal Treasures to withstand for long, relying only on the Master of Black Space’s methods to absorb and disintegrate through black hole vortices.

Thus.

Lin Yuan’s cosmic barrier formed outside his body began to erode shortly after contact with the black stream, creating large holes.

However, Lin Yuan’s internal cosmic foundation was deep, and each hole created by the erosion was instantly repaired.

This created a temporary balance between the black stream and the cosmic barrier Lin Yuan had formed.

Under the sky, the previously attacking and instinctively enraged Demon God suddenly paused, his hollow eyes fixed on Lin Yuan.

Since the arrival of the demonic calamity, all Eternal Lords were trapped, and the Demon God was invincible in this world, even the secret world created by the Eternal Lords.

In the face of the Demon God, it was just a hard shell, only capable of passive defense.

But the towering figure before him was the first life that could withstand his attack without retreating.

“What?”

“Lord Galaxy blocked it?”

Inside the secret world, several sect masters were astounded.

They could see that Lin Yuan was directly resisting the black stream without using any Eternal Treasures.

The cosmic barrier in contact with the black stream began to erode and form large holes shortly after.

It was clearly not an Eternal Treasure, since while Eternal Treasures could be corroded by the black stream, their defense could at least hold out for some time.

Corroded shortly after contact?

It could only be a technique Lin Yuan used.

The rapid recovery after being corroded was also in direct confrontation with the black stream.

“Lord Galaxy could actually directly withstand a strike from the Demon God?”

All the strong within the secret world found it unbelievable.

The Demon God is on par with a thirteenth-tier Eternal Lord.

If Lin Yuan could withstand a blow from the Demon God, wouldn’t that mean he could withstand a blow from an Eternal Lord?

Not an Eternal Lord, yet capable of directly withstanding a blow from one?

How is this possible?

“The power is very strong, and I must go all out to block it.” Lin Yuan looked at the constantly disappearing and recovering cosmic barrier with a slightly serious expression.

Since regaining his peak strength, he hadn’t really had to go all out, except for once, in the trial space opened by the Master of Wu Shan, where he unleashed a Chaotic Taiji Dao sword in full force.

But that was just a single move in full force, not an all-out effort; now Lin Yuan was going all out, even revealing his true form.

And compared to the full force at the trial space back then, how much more powerful is Lin Yuan now?
